exact_prompt_lines: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: Stage 3 web feature explainer, signature raw ingredient atlas.
Create a photorealistic true-overhead raw ingredient atlas with exactly six clearly separated stations and no labels. This establishes raw materials before preparation, not a recipe claim.
Scene: clean contemporary brushed stainless food-work surface in the Stage 2 pale-mineral world; no horizon, wall or shelf; camera exactly 90 degrees overhead and sensor parallel to table.
Layout: exact 4:3 centered composition, two rows of three, equal rhythm, clean outer margins, no grid lines, no overlaps and no seventh object group.

Top row: thyme sprig plus spoon-size pale amber honey dollop in a low off-white ceramic dish; one clean uncut directional fig leaf in an off-white tray, isolated and not presented as ready-to-eat; small roasted buckwheat groats in an off-white tray.
Bottom row: few short yellow-orange citrus peel strips; small actual-scale black sesame mound; shallow olive-gold oil dish plus very small actual-scale coarse sea-salt pinch.
Lighting: broad upper-left soft-directional source with gentle fill, 4300-4800K warm-neutral grade, soft contact shadows, retained stainless grain and ceramic edge thickness; all six stations sharp.
No text, labels, arrows, logo, packaging or watermark. Fig Leaf remains directional; no edible-safety, species, origin or benefit implication.

Avoid glass bottles, beakers, droppers, apothecary dishes, perfume, whiskey/spirit cues, cosmetics, wood, kraft, linen, twine, rustic patina, flowers, garnish theater, oversized salt, whole citrus, extra herbs, paper labels, colored light and unsupported claims.

Column 1 uses low oval off-white ingredient trays; column 2 small round prep bowls; column 3 low open yogurt bowls. Exactly three rows and columns, no printed grid and no tenth group.
Row 1 Thyme Honey: thyme plus honey; viscous amber base; dense ivory yogurt with one thin amber ribbon and sparse thyme through a ridge.
Row 2 Citrus Peel: short peel threads; filtered light yellow-orange prep; dense ivory yogurt with short embedded threads at two depths.
Row 3 Black Sesame: small seed mound; opaque matte charcoal paste; dense ivory/stone-grey yogurt with one retained marble and fine particles.
Use the series upper-left source, gentle fill, 4300-4800K grade, restrained contrast, ceramic thickness, plausible meniscus/paste/yogurt density and coherent contact shadows.

exact_prompt_lines: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: Stage 3 web detail proof, strict-side yogurt straining process.
Create a strict 90-degree side photograph of one vertical system: dense concentrate above, food-grade muslin on a perforated stainless frame, pale acid whey collecting below.

Same pale-mineral and stainless workspace. Same adult female maker at frame right in one-eye side profile, tied-back dark hair, charcoal shirt/apron, focused downward gaze; generic maker, not founder.

Apparatus already drains. Both hands lightly steady opposite outer frame edges without lifting, squeezing or twisting. Three to five natural gravity drips connect cloth underside to whey pan. One action only.

Dense ivory yogurt has uneven weight-bearing ridges; muslin is wet only at contact and shows woven thickness; level rectangular perforated frame rests on simple legs; shallow stainless pan holds pale translucent straw-yellow whey, not neon green.
Native 3:2, sensor parallel to apparatus side, 55-70mm perspective, camera at frame height, apparatus fully visible from yogurt top to pan base, f/8-like depth. No three-quarter or overhead cheat.
Use broad upper-left daylight, gentle fill, 4300-4800K grade, retained stainless highlights, muslin weave, dense dairy texture, whey translucency and grounded shadows.

Same pale-mineral/stainless workspace. Show only charcoal-apron torso, natural forearms and hands from lower chest down; crop face so it cannot read as founder portrait. One low off-white ceramic bowl grounded on stainless.

Dominant hand draws one broad stainless paddle slowly up and over, forming one heavy ridge. Other hand steadies bowl wall. Small plain stainless measuring cup sits beside bowl with thin residual amber coating; do not pour and fold simultaneously.

Dense ivory yogurt deforms around paddle and retains a broad ridge, not decorative whipped swirl. One thin amber internal ribbon with sparse actual-scale thyme remains along fold and continues into depth; no surface drizzle or garnish.
